newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline mixed, barges firm, U.S. grade steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline mixed, barges firm, U.S. grade steady.

text.p: NWE gasoline barges firmed on Friday amid tight Rotterdam supply, but European cargo prices eased on slack demand and arbitrage cargoes fob U.K. steadied on afternoon NYMEX gains, traders said.
Barges continued firm in tight Rotterdam supply, trading around $218 a tonne fob Rotterdam. But Eurograde cargo offers softened with very little European demand seen.
However, cargo prices for U.S. regular and superplus grades fob U.K. steadied with a U.K. refiner offering M4 at Oct NYMEX -6 cents a gallon compared with trade at -6.75 cents earlier in the week.
